newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean prices mostly flat.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean prices mostly flat.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn, wheat and soybean prices were mostly steady on Monday amid subdued dealings, grain dealers said.
Shipping delays on the Illinois River continued to slow movement of grain and soybeans to the U.S. Gulf.
One stretch of the Illinois River remained closed to navigation on Monday as a result of high water fed by recent rainfall, the U.S. Coast Guard said.
In export news, U.S. Agriculture Department officials have discussed the idea of providing credit guarantees on U.S. farm exports to Russia but reached no decision.
